horizon12.AR_definition: positive original association80 candidate score, training-only
horizon12.global_definition: at least one >=80% training airing from any training user; all training users included
horizon12.interpretation: EASE could supply or rerank scores for personally unobserved items learned from other training users, including items missed by pruned AR rules. It cannot learn an item with no >=80% global training evidence, or personalize a user with no usable >=80% history. Diagnostics are not proof of improvement; labels are not training features.
horizon12.personal_history_definition: at least one training airing with >=50% actual observed coverage; eligible program IDs only
